name: docker_helper
description: Inspect Docker containers/images on the host: list containers/images, get logs, resource stats, or full inspection details for a container, or general Docker system info. Read-only - does not start, stop, or modify containers.

action.description: list_containers: running (or all) containers. list_images: local images. logs: a container's recent logs. stats: live resource usage. inspect: full container details. docker_info: Docker system/daemon info.

container_id.description: Container ID or name. Required for logs, stats, inspect.

all_containers.description: For list_containers: include stopped containers too. Defaults to false (running only).

log_lines.description: Number of log lines to retrieve for action='logs'. Defaults to 50.
